summary: A fast, tense bluffing and deduction game where you hold one card at a time and try to deduce what everyone else is holding while avoiding elimination. Rounds last only a few minutes, so it plays as a light palate-cleanser or filler rather than a deep strategic experience.
praised: Extremely quick setup and round length
Surprising depth of deduction from a tiny 16-card deck
Great portability and low table footprint
Tense push-your-luck moments with the Guard and Baron
criticised: High variance - a single lucky/unlucky draw can decide a round
Player elimination means early-eliminated players wait for the round to end
Very light strategic depth for experienced gamers
Playing at higher player counts (5-6) dilutes information and increases luck

interaction.kind: bluffing, deduction, and direct targeted elimination

win_criteria: Most points, one or two sources

scoring.why: Favor tokens are won round-by-round by surviving or holding the highest card, and the first to reach the token threshold wins
